definitions: A straight-grained, reddish-brown timber from any of various tropical trees, especially from the genus Swietenia, widely used for furniture and other fine woodworking.
Any of various tropical trees yielding mahogany timber.
A reddish-brown colour, like that of mahogany wood.
examples: The antique desk was made of solid mahogany.
They planted a row of young mahogany trees.
She painted the walls a deep mahogany.
